heard: Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel They supplied provisions for the king and his household Each one was responsible for a month of the year Their names were recorded in the ancient scroll Then Abanadab ruled in all of Naphthah's door He had Solomon's daughter, Taphthah as his wife A bond of loyalty between the royal house And the administrate leaders of the land The hill country of Ephraim held Ben-Hur and Dacre in my bosom
